name: calling-agent
description: Real Estate WhatsApp AI + Calling Agent Prototype

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.db:migrate: for f in supabase/migrations/*.sql; do echo "== $f"; psql "$DATABASE_URL" -f "$f" || exit 1; done

comments.db:migrate: Runs every migration in supabase/migrations/ in filename order (all are idempotent). Alternatively paste them into Supabase SQL Editor — see docs/SETUP.md.
